stem.text: The diagram shows a slide of a transverse section of a stem. This diagram is the same size as the actual slide.

stem.alt: Rectangular slide outline containing a large circle with a small circle at its centre.

stem.text: A student observed this slide using a light microscope at a magnification of $\times 40$. The student made a plan drawing of the stem, which was $20\,\text{cm}$ in diameter.
The student labelled the plan ‘Transverse section of a stem $\times 40$’.
Which statement explains why this label is **not** correct?

A.text: The actual size of the stem should have been checked using an eyepiece graticule.

B.text: The actual size of the stem was smaller under low power.

C.text: The image size in the drawing was larger than $\times 40$.

D.text: The image size in the drawing was smaller than $\times 40$.
